description: Drafts or audits the AI-use statement and the LLM reproducibility appendix of a manuscript or proposal. Inventories every use of a language model in the project, separates writing assistance from use as a research method, fetches the target journal's or funder's current policy, places each disclosure where that policy wants it, and writes the appendix a replicator needs, with models, versions, dates, parameters, prompts, and validation. Use before submission, when a journal questionnaire asks about AI use, when a manuscript uses a model for coding, classification, OCR, or synthetic data, or when a co-author asks what must be declared. Codebook and validation design go to text-classification, and the full methods checklist to methods-reporting.
